```{r}
##------------ClinVar Sankey plot --------------------
make_sankey_clinvar <- function(df, points_col, colors_custom, clinvar) {
  
  df <- df %>% mutate(clinvar = {{ clinvar }})
  
  # Fix clinvar naming
  df$clinvar[df$clinvar == 'Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic'] <- "Likely pathogenic"
  df$clinvar[df$clinvar == 'Benign/Likely benign'] <- "Likely benign"
  
  # Dynamically pick the points column using {{ }}
  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(clinvar, {{ points_col }}) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Expand the dataframe
  expanded_df <- summary_data[rep(1:nrow(summary_data), summary_data$count), -3]
  rownames(expanded_df) <- NULL
  
  # Prepare for sankey
  sankey_data <- expanded_df %>%
    ggsankey::make_long(clinvar, {{ points_col }})
  
  # Factor levels
  levels_order <- c(
    'Benign', "Likely benign", "Likely Benign", 
    'Uncertain', "No Classification", 
    "Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic"
  )
  
  sankey_data$node <- factor(sankey_data$node, levels = levels_order)
  sankey_data$next_node <- factor(sankey_data$next_node, levels = levels_order)
  
  # Make the plot
  gc <- ggplot(sankey_data, aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    label = NA
  )) +
    geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "black") +
    geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sankey Diagram: ClinVar → ", rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))),
      fill = "Node Category"
    )
  
  return(gc)
}

##----- confusion matrix function ----
make_confusion_matrix_clinvar_chek2 <- function(df, points_col, clnsig_col, predictor, func_col, pred_col) {

  # ---- Collapse ClinVar ----
  df[[clnsig_col]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    df[[clnsig_col]] %in% c("Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") ~ "Pathogenic",
    df[[clnsig_col]] %in% c("Likely benign", "Likely Benign", "Benign/Likely benign") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ df[[clnsig_col]]
  )

  # ---- Collapse POINTS the same way ----
  df[[points_col]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    df[[points_col]] %in% c("Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") ~ "Pathogenic",
    df[[points_col]] %in% c("Likely benign", "Likely Benign", "Benign/Likely benign") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ df[[points_col]]
  )

  # ---- Only determinates ----
  df_det <- df[df[[points_col]] %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign"), ]

  # ---- All possible combinations ----
  all_levels <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    clnsig = c("Benign", "Pathogenic"),
    points = c("Benign", "Pathogenic")
  )

  # ---- Summary table ----
  summary_data <- df_det %>%
    dplyr::count(
      clnsig = .data[[clnsig_col]],
      points = .data[[points_col]],
      name = "count"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::right_join(all_levels, by = c("clnsig", "points")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      count = tidyr::replace_na(count, 0),
      consistency = ifelse(clnsig == points, "Consistent", "Inconsistent"),
      fill_status = ifelse(count == 0, "Zero", consistency)
    )

  # ---- Extract confusion matrix values ----
  TP <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Pathogenic" & summary_data$points == "Pathogenic"]
  TN <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Benign"     & summary_data$points == "Benign"]
  FP <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Benign"     & summary_data$points == "Pathogenic"]
  FN <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Pathogenic" & summary_data$points == "Benign"]

  TP <- sum(TP); TN <- sum(TN); FP <- sum(FP); FN <- sum(FN)

  # ---- Metrics ----
  sensitivity  <- TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity  <- TN / (TN + FP)
  concordance  <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
  
  denominator <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(TP + FP) *
  as.numeric(TP + FN) *
  as.numeric(TN + FP) *
  as.numeric(TN + FN)
)
  
  mcc <- ((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)) / denominator
  
  mcc <- ((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)) / denominator

  # convert NaN to 0
  mcc <- ifelse(is.nan(mcc) | is.infinite(mcc), 0, mcc)

  percent_classified <- (TP + TN + FP + FN) / nrow(df)

  metrics_df <- data.frame(
    TP = TP, TN = TN, FP = FP, FN = FN,
    Sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
    Specificity = round(specificity, 3),
    Concordance = round(concordance, 3),
    MCC = round(mcc, 3),
    Determinate_calls = round(percent_classified, 3)
  )
  
  #----- FP,FN Stats ----
  
  # Identify row-level FP and FN
  FP_rows <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] == "Benign"     & df[[points_col]] == "Pathogenic", ]
  FN_rows <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] == "Pathogenic" & df[[points_col]] == "Benign", ]

  
  get_stats <- function(df, func_col, pred_col) {
  
  func_vals <- df[[func_col]]
  pred_vals <- df[[pred_col]]
  
  has_func <- func_vals != 0 & !is.na(func_vals)
  has_pred <- pred_vals != 0 & !is.na(pred_vals)
  
  both <- has_func & has_pred
  
  same_direction <- both & (sign(func_vals) == sign(pred_vals))
  opp_direction  <- both & (sign(func_vals) != sign(pred_vals))
  
  # 4-way direction breakdown (only for opposite-direction variants)
  opp <- opp_direction

  opp_func_pos <- sum(opp & func_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_func_neg <- sum(opp & func_vals < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_pred_pos <- sum(opp & pred_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_pred_neg <- sum(opp & pred_vals < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    total                = nrow(df),
    func_nonzero         = sum(has_func),
    pred_nonzero         = sum(has_pred),
    both_nonzero         = sum(both),
    same_direction       = sum(same_direction),
    opposite_direction   = sum(opp_direction),
    only_functional      = sum(has_func & !has_pred),
    only_predictor       = sum(has_pred & !has_func),
    
    opp_func_positive     = opp_func_pos,
    opp_func_negative     = opp_func_neg,
    opp_pred_positive     = opp_pred_pos,
    opp_pred_negative     = opp_pred_neg
  )
  }
  
  FP_stats <- get_stats(FP_rows, func_col, pred_col)
  FN_stats <- get_stats(FN_rows, func_col, pred_col)
  
  FP_stats$predictor <- predictor
  FN_stats$predictor <- predictor

  # ---- Plot ----
  p <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = clnsig, y = points, fill = fill_status)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Consistent" = "#D8BFD8",
      "Inconsistent" = "#F2F2F2",
      "Zero" = "white"
    )) +
    labs(
      x = "ClinVar",
      y = paste0("Experimental + Predictive classification (", predictor, ")"),
      title = paste0(
        "(Determinates = ", nrow(df_det),
        ", Total = ", nrow(df),
        ", Error = ", round((FP + FN) / nrow(df) * 100, 2), "%)"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  list(plot = p, metrics = metrics_df, summary = summary_data,FP_stats = FP_stats,
  FN_stats = FN_stats, total_n = nrow(df))
}

save_my_plot <- function(plot, filename, folder,
                         width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300) {

  # Create folder if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists(folder)) {
    dir.create(folder, recursive = TRUE)
  }

  filepath <- file.path(folder, filename)

  ggsave(
    filename = filepath,
    plot = plot,
    dpi = dpi,
    device = "png",
    bg = "transparent",
    width = width,
    height = height
  )

  message("Saved: ", filepath)
}

)

  "sankey_clinvar_ExOP_AM_GeneSpecific.png",
  "sankey_clinvar_ExOP_MP2_GeneSpecific.png",

  "sankey_clinvar_OP_REVEL_Universal.png",
  "sankey_clinvar_OP_AM_Universal.png",
  "sankey_clinvar_OP_MP2_Universal.png"
)

square_plots_OP_ds <- c(
  "metrics_controls_GeneSpecific.png"
)

for (nm in names(clinvar_excalibr)) {
  if (nm %in% square_plots_OP) {
    w <- 7; h <- 7

    folder = file.path(dirname(OUT_DIR), "extended_data_figure_4"),
    width = w,
    height = h
  )
}

  } else if (nm %in% square_plots_OP_ds) {

  }

  }

    plot = clinvar_oddspath[[nm]],
    filename = nm,
    folder = file.path(dirname(OUT_DIR), "extended_data_figure_6"),
    width = w,
    height = h
  )

# Calibrated versions: real print size, baked-in name-only labels (no count
# boxes -- show_count = FALSE), 6pt Arial, 37 x 64mm excluding label overflow
# (see lib/sankey_calibrated.R, shared with the Fig 5/6 sankeys and the
# ClinGen panel below, which reuses levels_order_extdata_4_6 and sources
# sankey_calibrated.R again into its own fresh environment).
#
# Sourced into its own environment -- this file and lib/three_ring_donut.R
# (sourced later, for the Fig 9 donuts) declare colliding same-named globals
# (LABEL_PT, FONT_FAMILY, point_in_mm, ...) with different values; see the
# matching comment in Figure5_6.Rmd for the reproduced bug this avoids.
.sankey_lib <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
source("../../../src/lib/figures/sankey_calibrated.R", local = .sankey_lib)
make_sankey_calibrated <- .sankey_lib$make_sankey_calibrated

levels_order_extdata_4_6 <- c(
  'Benign', "Likely benign", "Likely Benign",
  'Uncertain', "No Classification",
  "Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic"
)

# make_sankey_clinvar() collapses "Benign/Likely benign" ->  "Likely
# benign" and "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic" -> "Likely pathogenic" on its
# own local copy of the data before factoring against levels_order (the
# controls_AM_GeneSpecific/controls_MP2_GeneSpecific sheets still use these
# raw un-collapsed labels -- reproduced: skipping this step left those rows
# outside levels_order, so factor() turned them into NA, and this library's
# own to_sentence_case(as.character(NA)) renders as the literal string
# "NANA", with a fully visible node box, rather than silently disappearing
# the way the original geom_sankey_label()-based PNG does). Repeated here
# so the calibrated versions match; the OP sheets already use the
# collapsed labels, but applying this is a harmless no-op there.
add_clinvar <- function(df) {
  df$clinvar <- df$clnsig_group_18_25
  df$clinvar[df$clinvar == 'Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic'] <- "Likely pathogenic"
  df$clinvar[df$clinvar == 'Benign/Likely benign'] <- "Likely benign"
  df
}
clinvar_AM_YP <- add_clinvar(clinvar_AM_YP)
clinvar_MP2_YP <- add_clinvar(clinvar_MP2_YP)
clinvar_REVEL_OP <- add_clinvar(clinvar_REVEL_OP)
clinvar_AM_OP <- add_clinvar(clinvar_AM_OP)
clinvar_MP2_OP <- add_clinvar(clinvar_MP2_OP)

sankey_clinvar_AM_calibrated <- make_sankey_calibrated(
  clinvar_AM_YP, source_col = clinvar, points_col = Class_AM,
  colors_custom = colors_custom, levels_order = levels_order_extdata_4_6,
  width_mm = 37, height_mm = 64, label_pt = 6, show_count = FALSE,
  wrap_destination_labels = TRUE
)

  clinvar_MP2_YP, source_col = clinvar, points_col = Class_MP2,
  colors_custom = colors_custom, levels_order = levels_order_extdata_4_6,
  width_mm = 37, height_mm = 64, label_pt = 6, show_count = FALSE,

)
```

```{r}
# ------ Sankey function for ClinGen ------

make_sankey_clingen <- function(df, points_col, colors_custom) {
  
  df <- df %>%
  filter(Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo != "VUS")

  
  # Fix clnsig_group naming
  df$Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo[df$Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo == 'Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic'] <- "Likely pathogenic"
  df$Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo[df$Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo == 'Benign/Likely benign'] <- "Likely benign"
  
  # Dynamically pick the points column using {{ }}
  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo, {{ points_col }}) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Expand the dataframe
  expanded_df <- summary_data[rep(1:nrow(summary_data), summary_data$count), -3]
  rownames(expanded_df) <- NULL
  
  # Prepare for sankey
  sankey_data <- expanded_df %>%
    ggsankey::make_long(Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo, {{ points_col }})
  
  # Factor levels
  levels_order <- c(
    'Benign', "Likely benign", "Likely Benign", 
    'Uncertain', "No Classification", 
    "Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic"
  )
  
  sankey_data$node <- factor(sankey_data$node, levels = levels_order)
  sankey_data$next_node <- factor(sankey_data$next_node, levels = levels_order)
  
  # Make the plot
  gc <- ggplot(sankey_data, aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    label = NA
  )) +
    geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "black") +
    geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sankey Diagram: ClinGen --> ", rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))),
      fill = "Node Category"
    )
  
  return(gc)
}

##----- confusion matrix function clingen ----
make_confusion_matrix_clingen <- function(df, points_col, clnsig_col, predictor, func_col, pred_col) {
  
  df <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] != "VUS", ]

  
  # ---- Collapse ClinGen ----
  df[[clnsig_col]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    df[[clnsig_col]] %in% c("Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") ~ "Pathogenic",
    df[[clnsig_col]] %in% c("Likely benign", "Likely Benign", "Benign/Likely benign") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ df[[clnsig_col]]
  )

  # ---- Collapse POINTS the same way ----
  df[[points_col]] <- dplyr::case_when(
    df[[points_col]] %in% c("Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") ~ "Pathogenic",
    df[[points_col]] %in% c("Likely benign", "Likely Benign", "Benign/Likely benign") ~ "Benign",
    TRUE ~ df[[points_col]]
  )

  # ---- Only determinates ----
  df_det <- df[df[[points_col]] %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign"), ]

  # ---- All possible combinations ----
  all_levels <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    clnsig = c("Benign", "Pathogenic"),
    points = c("Benign", "Pathogenic")
  )

  # ---- Summary table ----
  summary_data <- df_det %>%
    dplyr::count(
      clnsig = .data[[clnsig_col]],
      points = .data[[points_col]],
      name = "count"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::right_join(all_levels, by = c("clnsig", "points")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      count = tidyr::replace_na(count, 0),
      consistency = ifelse(clnsig == points, "Consistent", "Inconsistent"),
      fill_status = ifelse(count == 0, "Zero", consistency)
    )

  # ---- Extract confusion matrix values ----
  TP <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Pathogenic" & summary_data$points == "Pathogenic"]
  TN <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Benign"     & summary_data$points == "Benign"]
  FP <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Benign"     & summary_data$points == "Pathogenic"]
  FN <- summary_data$count[summary_data$clnsig == "Pathogenic" & summary_data$points == "Benign"]

  TP <- sum(TP); TN <- sum(TN); FP <- sum(FP); FN <- sum(FN)

  # ---- Metrics ----
  sensitivity  <- TP / (TP + FN)
  specificity  <- TN / (TN + FP)
  concordance  <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
  
  denominator <- sqrt(
  as.numeric(TP + FP) *
  as.numeric(TP + FN) *
  as.numeric(TN + FP) *
  as.numeric(TN + FN)
)
  
  mcc <- ((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)) / denominator
  
  mcc <- ((TP * TN) - (FP * FN)) / denominator

  # convert NaN to 0
  mcc <- ifelse(is.nan(mcc) | is.infinite(mcc), 0, mcc)

  percent_classified <- (TP + TN + FP + FN) / nrow(df)

  metrics_df <- data.frame(
    TP = TP, TN = TN, FP = FP, FN = FN,
    Sensitivity = round(sensitivity, 3),
    Specificity = round(specificity, 3),
    Concordance = round(concordance, 3),
    MCC = round(mcc, 3),
    Determinate_calls = round(percent_classified, 3)
  )
  
  #----- FP,FN Stats ----
  
  # Identify row-level FP and FN
  FP_rows <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] == "Benign"     & df[[points_col]] == "Pathogenic", ]
  FN_rows <- df[df[[clnsig_col]] == "Pathogenic" & df[[points_col]] == "Benign", ]

  
  get_stats <- function(df, func_col, pred_col) {
  
  func_vals <- df[[func_col]]
  pred_vals <- df[[pred_col]]
  
  has_func <- func_vals != 0 & !is.na(func_vals)
  has_pred <- pred_vals != 0 & !is.na(pred_vals)
  
  both <- has_func & has_pred
  
  same_direction <- both & (sign(func_vals) == sign(pred_vals))
  opp_direction  <- both & (sign(func_vals) != sign(pred_vals))
  
  # 4-way direction breakdown (only for opposite-direction variants)
  opp <- opp_direction

  opp_func_pos <- sum(opp & func_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_func_neg <- sum(opp & func_vals < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_pred_pos <- sum(opp & pred_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  opp_pred_neg <- sum(opp & pred_vals < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    total                = nrow(df),
    func_nonzero         = sum(has_func),
    pred_nonzero         = sum(has_pred),
    both_nonzero         = sum(both),
    same_direction       = sum(same_direction),
    opposite_direction   = sum(opp_direction),
    only_functional      = sum(has_func & !has_pred),
    only_predictor       = sum(has_pred & !has_func),
    
    opp_func_positive     = opp_func_pos,
    opp_func_negative     = opp_func_neg,
    opp_pred_positive     = opp_pred_pos,
    opp_pred_negative     = opp_pred_neg
  )
  }
  
  FP_stats <- get_stats(FP_rows, func_col, pred_col)
  FN_stats <- get_stats(FN_rows, func_col, pred_col)
  
  FP_stats$predictor <- predictor
  FN_stats$predictor <- predictor

  # ---- Plot ----
  p <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = clnsig, y = points, fill = fill_status)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Consistent" = "#D8BFD8",
      "Inconsistent" = "#F2F2F2",
      "Zero" = "white"
    )) +
    labs(
      x = "ClinGen",
      y = paste0("Experimental + Predictive classification (", predictor, ")"),
      title = paste0(
        "(Determinates = ", nrow(df_det),
        ", Total = ", nrow(df),
        ", Error = ", round((FP + FN) / nrow(df) * 100, 2), "%)"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  list(plot = p, metrics = metrics_df, summary = summary_data,FP_stats = FP_stats,
  FN_stats = FN_stats, total_n = nrow(df))
}
```

```{r}

#Extended Data Figure 6alt

# Alternate version of Extended Data Figure 6 (REVEL/AlphaMissense/MutPred2
# x ClinVar controls/ClinGen Evidence Repository, all via OddsPath/
# "Universal" calibration): adds a missense-only variant of every panel,
# doubling the current 12 sankeys+confusion-matrices to 24, so an
# All-variants block and a Missense-only block can sit side by side --
# essentially the current 3-column layout, repeated to the right. All
# charts are shrunk 50% linearly from Ext. Data Fig 6's own calibrated
# core dimensions (sankey 37x64mm -> 18.5x32mm, confusion matrix
# 26x23mm -> 13x11.5mm); font sizes stay the same (label_pt = 6
# throughout, matching the panel above) -- each chart's own *returned*
# width/height (which includes label/title overflow beyond that core, same
# as every other calibrated chart in this project) ends up larger than the
# core size alone, since the same-size text no longer shrinks with the box.
# Sankey node labels are abbreviated to P/LP/VUS/LB/B -- one
# label_overrides table covers both the ClinVar/ClinGen axis and the
# predictor axis, since they share the same raw label vocabulary; ClinGen's
# own "No Classification" bucket (its insufficient-evidence category,
# distinct from "Uncertain") maps to "VUS" too, since it plays the same
# role.
#
# Entirely new, isolated code -- doesn't reuse or modify any object from
# the Ext. Data Fig 6 block above, so that figure's own output can't
# regress. Does reuse this document's already-defined
# make_confusion_matrix_clinvar_chek2()/make_confusion_matrix_clingen()/
# add_clinvar()/fix_clingen_naming() helpers and colors_custom/
# levels_order_extdata_4_6/make_sankey_calibrated()/
# make_confusion_matrix_calibrated(), all already in scope from earlier
# chunks in this document.

EXT_DATA_FIG_6ALT_DIR <- file.path(dirname(OUT_DIR), "extended_data_figure_6alt")

SANKEY_6ALT_WIDTH_MM <- 18.5
SANKEY_6ALT_HEIGHT_MM <- 32
CM_6ALT_WIDTH_MM <- 13
CM_6ALT_HEIGHT_MM <- 11.5

label_overrides_6alt <- c(
  "Benign" = "B", "Likely benign" = "LB", "Likely Benign" = "LB",
  "Uncertain" = "VUS", "No Classification" = "VUS",
  "Likely pathogenic" = "LP", "Likely Pathogenic" = "LP", "Pathogenic" = "P"
)

# simplified_consequence lives on every OP sheet (same column Figure5_6.Rmd's
# own consequence_filter param uses) -- no filtering infrastructure needed
# beyond this.
filter_missense_6alt <- function(df) df[df$simplified_consequence == "missense_variant", ]

PREDICTORS_6ALT <- list(
  REVEL = list(class_col = "Class_OP_REVEL", pred_col = "Points_REVEL_GenomeWide"),
  AM    = list(class_col = "Class_OP_AM",    pred_col = "Points_AM_GenomeWide"),
  MP2   = list(class_col = "Class_OP_MP2",   pred_col = "Points_MP2_GenomeWide")
)

# ---- ClinVar controls ----

clinvar_op_raw_6alt <- list(REVEL = clinvar_REVEL_OP, AM = clinvar_AM_OP, MP2 = clinvar_MP2_OP)

build_clinvar_op_6alt <- function(predictor_name, consequence) {
  spec <- PREDICTORS_6ALT[[predictor_name]]
  df <- clinvar_op_raw_6alt[[predictor_name]]
  if (consequence == "missense") df <- filter_missense_6alt(df)

  cm <- make_confusion_matrix_clinvar_chek2(
    df, spec$class_col, "clnsig_group_18_25", paste0(predictor_name, "_OP"),
    "OP_points", spec$pred_col
  )
  cm_calibrated <- make_confusion_matrix_calibrated(
    TP = cm$metrics$TP, TN = cm$metrics$TN, FP = cm$metrics$FP, FN = cm$metrics$FN,
    total_n = cm$total_n, matrix_width_mm = CM_6ALT_WIDTH_MM, matrix_height_mm = CM_6ALT_HEIGHT_MM,
    x_label = "ClinVar classification", y_label = NULL
  )

  df_sankey <- add_clinvar(df)
  sankey_calibrated <- make_sankey_calibrated(
    df_sankey, source_col = clinvar, points_col = !!rlang::sym(spec$class_col),
    colors_custom = colors_custom, levels_order = levels_order_extdata_4_6,
    width_mm = SANKEY_6ALT_WIDTH_MM, height_mm = SANKEY_6ALT_HEIGHT_MM, label_pt = 6,
    show_count = FALSE, wrap_destination_labels = TRUE, label_overrides = label_overrides_6alt
  )

  list(cm = cm_calibrated, sankey = sankey_calibrated)
}

for (predictor_name in names(PREDICTORS_6ALT)) {
  for (consequence in c("all", "missense")) {
    panel <- build_clinvar_op_6alt(predictor_name, consequence)
    ggsave(
      file.path(EXT_DATA_FIG_6ALT_DIR, sprintf("sankey_clinvar_OP_%s_Universal_%s_calibrated.pdf", predictor_name, consequence)),
      panel$sankey$plot, width = panel$sankey$width_mm, height = panel$sankey$height_mm,
      units = 'mm', device = cairo_pdf, create.dir = TRUE
    )
    ggsave(
      file.path(EXT_DATA_FIG_6ALT_DIR, sprintf("cm_clinvar_OP_%s_Universal_%s_calibrated.pdf", predictor_name, consequence)),
      panel$cm$plot, width = panel$cm$width_mm, height = panel$cm$height_mm,
      units = 'mm', device = cairo_pdf, create.dir = TRUE
    )
  }
}

# ---- ClinGen Evidence Repository ----

clingen_op_raw_6alt <- list(REVEL = ClinGen_REVEL_OP, AM = ClinGen_AM_OP, MP2 = ClinGen_MP2_OP)

build_clingen_op_6alt <- function(predictor_name, consequence) {
  spec <- PREDICTORS_6ALT[[predictor_name]]
  df <- clingen_op_raw_6alt[[predictor_name]]
  if (consequence == "missense") df <- filter_missense_6alt(df)

  cm <- make_confusion_matrix_clingen(
    df, spec$class_col, "Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo", paste0(predictor_name, "_OP"),
    "OP_points", spec$pred_col
  )
  cm_calibrated <- make_confusion_matrix_calibrated(
    TP = cm$metrics$TP, TN = cm$metrics$TN, FP = cm$metrics$FP, FN = cm$metrics$FN,
    total_n = cm$total_n, matrix_width_mm = CM_6ALT_WIDTH_MM, matrix_height_mm = CM_6ALT_HEIGHT_MM,
    x_label = "ClinGen classification", y_label = NULL
  )

  df_sankey <- df %>% filter(Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo != "VUS")
  df_sankey <- fix_clingen_naming(df_sankey)
  sankey_calibrated <- make_sankey_calibrated(
    df_sankey, source_col = Updated_Classification_ClinGen_repo, points_col = !!rlang::sym(spec$class_col),
    colors_custom = colors_custom, levels_order = levels_order_extdata_4_6,
    width_mm = SANKEY_6ALT_WIDTH_MM, height_mm = SANKEY_6ALT_HEIGHT_MM, label_pt = 6,
    show_count = FALSE, wrap_destination_labels = TRUE, label_overrides = label_overrides_6alt
  )

  list(cm = cm_calibrated, sankey = sankey_calibrated)
}

for (predictor_name in names(PREDICTORS_6ALT)) {
  for (consequence in c("all", "missense")) {
    panel <- build_clingen_op_6alt(predictor_name, consequence)
    ggsave(
      file.path(EXT_DATA_FIG_6ALT_DIR, sprintf("sankey_clingen_OP_%s_Universal_%s_calibrated.pdf", predictor_name, consequence)),
      panel$sankey$plot, width = panel$sankey$width_mm, height = panel$sankey$height_mm,
      units = 'mm', device = cairo_pdf, create.dir = TRUE
    )
    ggsave(
      file.path(EXT_DATA_FIG_6ALT_DIR, sprintf("cm_clingen_OP_%s_Universal_%s_calibrated.pdf", predictor_name, consequence)),
      panel$cm$plot, width = panel$cm$width_mm, height = panel$cm$height_mm,
      units = 'mm', device = cairo_pdf, create.dir = TRUE
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Extended Data Figure 7 (VUS AM and MP2)

VUS_AM_YP =read_excel(file.path(DATA_DIR, "supplementary_data/Supplementary_Data_5.xlsx"), sheet = "VUS_AM")

VUS_MP2_YP = read_excel(file.path(DATA_DIR, "supplementary_data/Supplementary_Data_5.xlsx"), sheet = "VUS_MP2")

VUS_REVEL_YP = read_excel(file.path(DATA_DIR, "supplementary_data/Supplementary_Data_5.xlsx"), sheet = "VUS_REVEL")

make_sankey_VUS <- function(df, points_col, colors_custom) {
  
  # Dynamically pick the points column using {{ }}
  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(clinvar_sig_2025, {{ points_col }}) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Expand the dataframe
  expanded_df <- summary_data[rep(1:nrow(summary_data), summary_data$count), -3]
  rownames(expanded_df) <- NULL
  
  # Prepare for sankey
  sankey_data <- expanded_df %>%
    ggsankey::make_long(clinvar_sig_2025, {{ points_col }})
  
  # Factor levels
  levels_order <- c(
    -12:-1, "Uncertain significance","No evidence", "Benign", "Likely benign", "Likely Benign", 
    "Uncertain", "Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic",
    0, "No Classification", "Conflicting evidence", 1:12
  )
  
  sankey_data$node <- factor(sankey_data$node, levels = levels_order)
  sankey_data$next_node <- factor(sankey_data$next_node, levels = levels_order)
  
  # Make the plot
  gc <- ggplot(sankey_data, aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    label = NA
  )) +
    geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "black") +
    geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sankey Diagram: VUS --> ", rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))),
      fill = "Node Category"
    )
  
  return(gc)
}



make_uncertain_confusion <- function(df, points_col, xlabel) {
  
  points_col_name <- rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))

  # count predicted categories
  summary_data <- df %>%
    count(pred = .data[[points_col_name]], name = "count")

  # ensure all 5 categories appear
  all_levels <- c("Pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic",
                  "Benign", "Likely Benign", "Uncertain")

  summary_data <- summary_data %>%
    complete(pred = all_levels, fill = list(count = 0))

  grand_total <- sum(summary_data$count)
  uncertain_count <- summary_data$count[summary_data$pred == "Uncertain"]
  reclass_prop <- round((1 - (uncertain_count / grand_total)) * 100, 2)

  # single-row confusion matrix style plot
  p <- ggplot(summary_data,
              aes(x = pred,
                  y = "ClinVar Uncertain",
                  fill = pred)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = count), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom
    ) +
    labs(
      x = xlabel,
      y = "",
      title = paste0(
        "VUS Reclassification",
        "Total = ", nrow(df),
        " | Reclassifciation = ", reclass_prop, "%"
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )

  return(p)
}

sankey_VUS_AM_YP <- make_sankey_VUS(VUS_AM_YP, Class_AM, colors_custom)

sankey_VUS_MP2_YP <- make_sankey_VUS(VUS_MP2_YP, Class_MP2, colors_custom)

# A plain as.integer() cast here would silently turn every "Conflicting
# evidence" row (a real, intentional category -- see docs/
# variant_classification.md) into NA, since as.integer() can't parse that
# string (reproduced: this rendered as a mislabeled/unlabeled node in both
# the PNG below and the calibrated PDF further down). Use the same
# regex-guarded normalizer as the Extended Data Figure 9 points charts
# below instead: it cleans up numeric-looking strings (dropping a

vus_revel_conflicting_raw <- as.character(VUS_REVEL_YP$Conflicting_REVEL)

VUS_REVEL_YP$Conflicting_REVEL <- ifelse(
  grepl("^-?\\d+(\\.0+)?$", vus_revel_conflicting_raw),
  as.character(as.integer(as.numeric(vus_revel_conflicting_raw))),
  vus_revel_conflicting_raw
)
```

```{r}
#extended data fig 8

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

summ_gene_pct <- function(df, points_col, predictor_label) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Gene), !is.na(.data[[points_col]])) %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    summarize(
      n_total  = n(),
      n_0to5   = sum(.data[[points_col]] >= 0 & .data[[points_col]] <= 5),
      pct_vus_remaining = 100 * n_0to5 / n_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Predictor = predictor_label)
}

# --- per predictor ---

revel <- summ_gene_pct(VUS_REVEL_YP, "Total_Points_REVEL", "REVEL")
am    <- summ_gene_pct(VUS_AM_YP,    "Total_Points_AM",    "AM")
mp2   <- summ_gene_pct(VUS_MP2_YP,   "Total_Points_MP2",   "MP2")

pred_df <- bind_rows(revel, am, mp2)

# --- overall: mean across predictors (swap to max() if you want "worst-case") ---
overall_df <- pred_df %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarize(
    n_total = sum(n_total),
    pct_vus_remaining = mean(pct_vus_remaining, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Predictor = "Overall")

plot_df <- bind_rows(overall_df, pred_df) %>%
  mutate(Predictor = factor(Predictor, levels = c("Overall", "REVEL", "AM", "MP2")))

# --- gene order = ranked by Overall ---
gene_order <- plot_df %>%
  filter(Predictor == "Overall") %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_vus_remaining)) %>%   # highest % remaining at top
  pull(Gene)

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(Gene = factor(Gene, levels = gene_order))

# --- zoom x-axis to your data range ---
x_min <- floor(min(plot_df$pct_vus_remaining, na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5
x_max <- ceiling(max(plot_df$pct_vus_remaining, na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5

xy = ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = pct_vus_remaining, y = Gene)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x_min, xend = x_max, yend = Gene),
               linewidth = 0.35, color = "grey90") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Predictor) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(x_min, x_max),
    breaks = seq(x_min, x_max, by = 10),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  labs(x = "% VUS remaining", y = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  )

ggsave('../../../data/output/figures/extended_data_figure_8/rank_based_plot.png',xy, dpi = 300, device = 'png', bg = 'transparent', create.dir = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#extended data fig 8

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


make_heat_df <- function(df, gene_col = "Gene", points_col, predictor_label) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[gene_col]]), !is.na(.data[[points_col]])) %>%
    count(.data[[gene_col]], .data[[points_col]], name = "n") %>%
    group_by(.data[[gene_col]]) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    rename(
      Gene = !!gene_col,
      Points = !!points_col
    ) %>%
    mutate(Predictor = predictor_label)
}

heat_revel <- make_heat_df(
  VUS_REVEL_YP,
  points_col = "Total_Points_REVEL",
  predictor_label = "REVEL"
)

heat_am <- make_heat_df(
  VUS_AM_YP,
  points_col = "Total_Points_AM",
  predictor_label = "AM"
)

heat_mp2 <- make_heat_df(
  VUS_MP2_YP,
  points_col = "Total_Points_MP2",
  predictor_label = "MP2"
)

heat_df_all <- bind_rows(heat_revel, heat_am, heat_mp2) %>%
  mutate(Predictor = factor(Predictor, levels = c("REVEL", "AM", "MP2")))

xx = ggplot(heat_df_all, aes(x = Points, y = Gene, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Predictor) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Proportion") +
  labs(
    x = "Total points",
    y = "Gene"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave('../../../data/output/figures/extended_data_figure_8/points_heatmap.png',xx, dpi = 300, device = 'png', bg = 'transparent', create.dir = TRUE)
```

```{r}
gnomad_REVEL_YP = read_excel(file.path(DATA_DIR, "supplementary_data/Supplementary_Data_5.xlsx"), sheet = "gnomAD_REVEL",col_types = 'text')

make_sankey_gnomad <- function(df, points_col, colors_custom) {
  
  df$gnomad = 'Gnomad'
  
  # Dynamically pick the points column using {{ }}
  summary_data <- df %>%
    group_by(gnomad, {{ points_col }}) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Expand the dataframe
  expanded_df <- summary_data[rep(1:nrow(summary_data), summary_data$count), -3]
  rownames(expanded_df) <- NULL
  
  # Prepare for sankey
  sankey_data <- expanded_df %>%
    ggsankey::make_long(gnomad, {{ points_col }})
  
  # Factor levels
  levels_order <- c(
    -12:-1, "Gnomad","No evidence", "Benign", "Likely benign", "Likely Benign", 
    "Uncertain", "Likely pathogenic", "Likely Pathogenic", "Pathogenic",
    0, "No Classification", "Conflicting evidence", 1:12 
  )
  
  sankey_data$node <- factor(sankey_data$node, levels = levels_order)
  sankey_data$next_node <- factor(sankey_data$next_node, levels = levels_order)
  
  # Make the plot
  gc <- ggplot(sankey_data, aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    label = node
  )) +
    geom_sankey(flow.alpha = 0.7, node.color = "black") +
    geom_sankey_label(size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_custom) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Sankey Diagram: gnomad --> ", rlang::as_name(rlang::ensym(points_col))),
      fill = "Node Category"
    )
  
  return(gc)
}
```

```{r}
#donut plots extended figure 9

#Donut plots Figure

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)
library(geomtextpath)
library(extrafont)
library(grid)

loadfonts(device = 'all')


###----- 1. Load and filter the dataset----

gnomad_REVEL_YP$Total_Points_REVEL = as.integer(gnomad_REVEL_YP$Total_Points_REVEL)

df_classified <- gnomad_REVEL_YP %>%
  mutate(
    point_source = case_when(
      Fxn_points != 0 & Points_REVEL_GeneSpecific_GenomeWide == 0 ~ "Functional only",
      Fxn_points == 0 & Points_REVEL_GeneSpecific_GenomeWide != 0 ~ "Predictive only",
      Fxn_points != 0 & Points_REVEL_GeneSpecific_GenomeWide != 0 ~ "Both",
      Fxn_points == 0 & Points_REVEL_GeneSpecific_GenomeWide == 0 ~ "No evidence",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    conflict_status = ifelse(
      Conflicting_REVEL == "Conflicting evidence",
      "Conflicting",
      "No conflict"
    )
  )


# Remove rows that have no point source at all
df_classified <- df_classified %>% filter(point_source != "None")

###------------------------------------------------------------
### 2. Summaries for classification bins
###------------------------------------------------------------

plot_summary <- df_classified %>%
  count(Total_Points_REVEL, point_source, conflict_status) %>%
  complete(
    Total_Points_REVEL,
    point_source = c("Functional only", "Predictive only", "Both"),
    conflict_status = c("Conflicting", "No conflict"),
    fill = list(n = 0))

### Re-bin pathogenicity buckets
plot_summary_2 <- plot_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Points_REVEL = cut(
      Total_Points_REVEL,
      breaks = c(-Inf, -12, -6, -3, 0,0.000001,4, 6, 10, 13, Inf),
      labels = c("< -12", "-12 to -7", "-6 to -4", "-3 to -1","0","1 to 3",
                 "4 to 5", "6 to 9", "10 to 12", "> 12"),
      right = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Total_Points_REVEL) %>%
  mutate(total_variants = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()


###------------------------------------------------------------
### 3. Ring geometry and plot functions (shared with Figure 6c)
###------------------------------------------------------------
# build_three_rings(), make_three_ring_plot(), make_three_ring_plot_no_labels(),
# and the calibrated real-print-size variant (make_three_ring_plot_calibrated()
# and its helpers) all live in lib/three_ring_donut.R now, shared with
# Figure5_6.Rmd's equivalent donut charts.
#
# Sourced into its own environment, not straight into globalenv: this file
# declares top-level constants (LABEL_PT, FONT_FAMILY, point_in_mm, ...) that
# collide with lib/sankey_calibrated.R's own same-named constants (different
# values) -- sourcing both straight into globalenv in the same document lets
# whichever is sourced last silently clobber the other's globals (reproduced
# in Figure5_6.Rmd: a later three_ring_donut.R source() call silently shrank
# every subsequent make_sankey_calibrated() call's default label size). This
# document doesn't source sankey_calibrated.R today, but keeping the same
# isolated-sourcing pattern here avoids re-introducing that bug if a future
# supplementary sankey chart is added to it.
.three_ring_lib <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
source("../../../src/lib/figures/three_ring_donut.R", local = .three_ring_lib)
make_three_ring_plot_calibrated <- .three_ring_lib$make_three_ring_plot_calibrated
make_three_ring_plot <- .three_ring_lib$make_three_ring_plot
make_three_ring_plot_no_labels <- .three_ring_lib$make_three_ring_plot_no_labels

# The outer circle's own placed diameter in the assembled figure (mm) -- not
# the panel/canvas width, just the ring itself.
RING_DIAMETER_MM <- 34.5


###------------------------------------------------------------
### 5. Build plots for bins (pathogenic / uncertain / benign)
###------------------------------------------------------------
#VUS_REVEL_YP$Total_Points_REVEL


pathogenic <- plot_summary_2 %>%
  filter(Total_Points_REVEL %in% c("6 to 9", "10 to 12"))

uncertain <- plot_summary_2 %>%
  filter(Total_Points_REVEL %in% c("0","1 to 3", "4 to 5"))

benign <- plot_summary_2 %>%
  filter(Total_Points_REVEL %in% c("< -12", "-12 to -7", "-6 to -4", "-3 to -1"))

# Produce the plots with labels and without labels
path_plot <- make_three_ring_plot(pathogenic, "Pathogenic range")
unc_plot  <- make_three_ring_plot(uncertain, "Uncertain range")
ben_plot  <- make_three_ring_plot(benign, "Benign range")

path_plot_no_lab <- make_three_ring_plot_no_labels(pathogenic, "Pathogenic range")
unc_plot_no_lab  <- make_three_ring_plot_no_labels(uncertain, "Uncertain range")
ben_plot_no_lab  <- make_three_ring_plot_no_labels(benign, "Benign range")

path_plot
unc_plot
ben_plot

# nolab filenames -- ben_/unc_ were previously swapped relative to their
# plot data (pie_ben_..._nolab.png held the uncertain plot and vice versa);
# fixed here to match, alongside adding the previously-ungenerated lab
# versions and the new calibrated (real-print-size) versions.
ggsave('../../../data/output/figures/extended_data_figure_9/pie_path_gnomAD_ExOP_REVEL_GeneSpecific_nolab.png',path_plot_no_lab, dpi = 300, device = 'png', bg = 'transparent', width = 7, height = 7, create.dir = TRUE)

ggsave('../../../data/output/figures/extended_data_figure_9/pie_unc_gnomAD_ExOP_REVEL_GeneSpecific_nolab.png',unc_plot_no_lab, dpi = 300, device = 'png', bg = 'transparent', width = 7, height = 7, create.dir = TRUE)

ggsave('../../../data/output/figures/extended_data_figure_9/pie_path_gnomAD_ExOP_REVEL_GeneSpecific_lab.png',path_plot, dpi = 300, device = 'png', bg = 'transparent', width = 7, height = 7, create.dir = TRUE)
ggsave('../../../data/output/figures/extended_data_figure_9/pie_ben_gnomAD_ExOP_REVEL_GeneSpecific_lab.png',ben_plot, dpi = 300, device = 'png', bg = 'transparent', width = 7, height = 7, create.dir = TRUE)
ggsave('../../../data/output/figures/extended_data_figure_9/pie_unc_gnomAD_ExOP_REVEL_GeneSpecific_lab.png',unc_plot, dpi = 300, device = 'png', bg = 'transparent', width = 7, height = 7, create.dir = TRUE)

# Calibrated versions: real print size, baked-in labels (see lib/three_ring_donut.R)
path_calibrated <- make_three_ring_plot_calibrated(pathogenic)
unc_calibrated  <- make_three_ring_plot_calibrated(uncertain)
ben_calibrated  <- make_three_ring_plot_calibrated(benign)
```
